name: LibreSpeed
blurb: Check the speed of your Internet connection.
description:
Check the speed of your Internet connection.

Test servers are provided by Consortium GARR, B2B Risk and several project contributors.

Features:

* Download and Upload tests
* Ping and Jitter test
* IP address, ISP and distance detection
* Multiple test servers
* Share your results
